solution:
The correct answer is __**1 - b, 2 - a, 3 - d, 4 - c.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The correct Matching Pairs are

 
 

 1) Central
 b) Mumbai CST
 
 

 2) Northern
 a) New Delhi
 
 

 
 
3) Eastern

 
 d)Kolkata
 
 

 4) Southern
 c) Chennai
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Railway** – Headquarters: **Mumbai CST** (Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus)

 
 
• one of the largest and oldest zones in the Indian Railway network.
 
• Its headquarters is located at **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus** (CST)
 
 
• A UNESCO World Heritage Site in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• It covers a large part of Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh, and some parts of Karnataka.
 
 
 
• **Northern Railway** – Headquarters: **New Delhi**
 
 
• **​T**he largest railway zone in terms of route kilometres.
 
• Northern Railway covers several important states like Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttar Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Eastern Railway** – Headquarters: **Kolkata**
 
 
• **​T**he oldest railway zones in India.
 
• Its headquarters is located in **Kolkata**, West Bengal.
 
• This zone primarily covers West Bengal and Jharkhand, and its network includes important rail routes like the Howrah–Delhi and Howrah–Mumbai routes.
 
 
 
• **Southern Railway** – Headquarters: **Chennai****​**
 
 
• **Southern Railway** covers the southern part of India, including Tamil Nadu, Kerala, parts of Karnataka, and Puducherry.
 
• Its headquarters is in **Chennai**, Tamil Nadu.
 
• It operates important rail routes connecting major southern cities and is known for operating several key passenger and freight services in the region.
